title: Show how many documents are in the library at the top of the list
objective: Show how many documents are in the library at the top of the list, like "5 documents", in an element with data-testid="doc-count" above the list. Under a search it reads "2 of 5 documents" (matches of all). One document reads "1 document". An empty library keeps its empty state and shows no count.
acceptance: The library reads "5 documents" above the list
Under a search it reads "N of 5 documents"
An empty library shows its empty state and no "0 documents"
plan_summary: Count listDocuments with and without q in libraryPage; render above the list.
